pages.title: 01 // DECORATION VS STRUCTURE
pages.content:
Designers decorate. Graphic engineers calculate. Swiss Brutalism is honest geometry.

Soft drop shadows, rounded corners, and stock photos are noise disguised as design. Swiss Brutalism uses 1px grid lines, JetBrains Mono typography, and high contrast telemetry to show raw system bones.

pages.title: 02 // THE SEED PARADOX
pages.content:
Storing 10,000 3D graphic assets takes 50 Gigabytes. Storing 10,000 seed strings takes 200 Kilobytes.

Passing a seed string into a procedural Canvas engine calculates mathematical visuals in real-time inside the reader's browser at 60 FPS.

pages.title: 03 // ZERO BACKEND COST & FORM FOLLOWS FUNCTION
pages.content: Client-side Canvas rendering + Cloudflare Workers edge proxy = Zero cloud server bill. Every reader gets a unique, mathematically perfect presentation.
